summary: M3-Brigade Acquisition V Corp. (a SPAC) filed an 8-K reporting mutual termination of its Business Combination Agreement with ReserveOne, Inc., originally signed July 7, 2025, due to changed market conditions in digital assets. The termination was effective June 12, 2026, under Section 7.1(a) of the BCA, with only customary survival provisions. Concurrently, the SPAC will seek shareholder approval to extend its combination deadline from August 2, 2026 to August 2, 2027. No termination fee was disclosed. No new target was announced. The risk-arb angle: watch for shareholder vote on extension and ability to find a new deal within the extended window.
